rationale: Evidence shows positive gain with 2-4s delay and long self-draining tau. u=0.4 drives y down to ~0.28 (E1) and from 0.62 down at -0.010/s (E12); u=0.6 drives y from 0.12 to 0.615 over 42s with slope falling 0.020 to 0.0074 (E5-E10); u=0 decays to ~0.12 with tau ~12-14s (E4); u=0.7 still rising +0.02/s at 0.5 (E2-E3). First-order fit to u=0.6 gives y_eq~0.82 tau~30s, while u=0.4 eq~0.25 implies strong nonlinearity/deadzone. Linearized deadzone fit y_eq=K*(u-dz) gives dz~0.30 K~2.7. Zero-crossing of slope at y~0.58: u=0.6 +0.0093/s vs u=0.4 -0.0104/s interpolates to u_eq~0.52 for 0.6. Hence feedforward ff=0.297+target/2.72 (~0.517 at 0.6). PI corrects residual: Kp=0.55 gives loop gain ~0.8-1.5 without exciting 3s delay, Ki=0.10 Ti~5.5s corrects 0.05 error in ~10-15s within 30s settling window. Integral gated to |e|<0.20 and clamped to +-0.25 leaves authority for ff error up to 0.25 (covers H6 0.55-0.70 uncertainty) while preventing windup during initial far approach. 1.5s EMA suppresses +-0.01 noise (std<0.02). 0.85 max and 0.75/0.80 safety caps prevent 0.9 hard cutoff given max rate 0.08/s.

extra.machine_card: Reservoir, positive gain: higher u raises level. Lag: 2-4s pure delay (E4 kept rising 1.2s after u->0, E5 flat 2-3s after u->0.6) plus slow first-order tau ~30s near 0.6 (slopes 0.020 at y0.22 to 0.0074 at y0.60 under u=0.6) and ~12-14s near drain (u=0 slope -0.029 at y0.41, -0.019 at y0.16). Gain nonlinear: u=0.4 equilibrium ~0.25-0.28 (E1 0.38->0.28 slope still -0.003), u=0.6 equilibrium ~0.80-0.83 (extrapolated, still +0.0074 at 0.615), u=0.7 eq >1.0 (still +0.021 at 0.54). Fits deadzone dz~0.30 K~2.7. Self-draining: u=0 falls 0.56->0.12 in 19s toward ~0. Dead zone below ~0.2-0.3 suspected but low confidence. Noise zero-mean +-0.01, std <0.02. Hold for 0.6 needs u~0.52 (interpolated between +0.009 at u0.6 and -0.010 at u0.4), not 0.60 (0.60 still rising). Worst rate 0.08/unit/s.
extra.predicted_behavior: From low level, saturates near 0.79-0.85 then glides into band in ~25-35s; from near band, enters 0.55-0.65 within ~10s and stays. Settles to 0.60 +-0.02 with <0.03 overshoot in true state, no ringing above 0.65 and far from 0.85/0.9. Steady duty ~0.51-0.55 for 0.6 target, integral trims any 0.1 feedforward miss within settling window. Time in band after 30s >85% in nominal plant.
